Gavi comes on in the second half to mark his return at action after more than six months out Match Information Close La Liga La Liga Stage Matchday 28 Referee Juan Martínez Munuera Stadium Spotify Camp Nou Attendance 56,483 All times local UTC FT' That's all for today folks... Thoughts now swing back to the Champions League and Barça's second leg of their last 16 tie against Newcastle United. The game at Spotify Camp Nou kicks off at 6.45pm CET on Wednesday - see you there! Barça appeared in control at home to Sevilla after Raphinha dispatched not one but two penalties in the opening 21 minutes following first a foul on Cancelo and then a handball. Dani Olmo coolly slotted home a third and it looked plain sailing for the blaugranes, however, a goal from Oso in injury time has thrown the visitors a lifeline.
